scope: Only conservative outer-partition closure semantics and hard-budget feasibility; preserve old files and all scientific choices
enclosure: Original r4_cz_envelope_model.py and representation/guard/evaluation/support primitives unchanged; new corrected engine only

COARSE.minimum_derivation: D=sum min integer k>=0 with extent/2^k<=terminal; D internal path nodes + D certified rejected siblings + 1 terminal leaf = 2D+1 requests for full queue exhaustion
COARSE.path_reach_vs_partition_close: 2D may reach first terminal child, but last sibling still needs classification; outer partition completion requires 2D+1
COARSE.maximum_formula: min(structural ceiling, floor(0.8*runtime envelope / old frozen worst cell cost), floor(storage envelope / conservative bytes per request))

FINE.minimum_derivation: D=sum min integer k>=0 with extent/2^k<=terminal; D internal path nodes + D certified rejected siblings + 1 terminal leaf = 2D+1 requests for full queue exhaustion
FINE.path_reach_vs_partition_close: 2D may reach first terminal child, but last sibling still needs classification; outer partition completion requires 2D+1
FINE.maximum_formula: min(structural ceiling, floor(0.8*runtime envelope / old frozen worst cell cost), floor(storage envelope / conservative bytes per request))

ladder_selection: For each resolution test candidate budgets in ascending order on BOTH declared fixtures and BOTH B0/CZ. First candidate with valid execution, domain_partition_closed, search_budget_closed and independently sealed reference retention in all four runs is selected. Stop ladder for that resolution on first success. At final failure no C4/F4; freeze NOT_SELECTED and SEARCH_CLOSURE_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

fixtures.state_rule: First prior-policy domain corner, no case inputs

measurement_generation: Use original levels_numpy and point_geometry for each declared state/depth; feature via unchanged WINDOW_SHAPE_Q2; no added noise or source spectrum. State is confined to generator/evaluator, never supplied to support engine.

fixture_bearing_cutoff.rule: Inherited noiseless numerical control: exact matched bearing reference has cmin=0 at generating state; fixed 1e-20 allowance, not tuned. This rule is fixture-only; future 21 cases retain manifest cutoffs unchanged.

fixture_generation_budget.unit: each generator/evaluator validation and each admitted forward/profile call counted

fixture_runtime_targets: COARSE 30 minutes and FINE 60 minutes per raw run, advisory calibration envelopes; hard operation/storage caps enforce termination. Sequential processes, no timer-based budget increase.
traversal: original deterministic BFS, lower child first; largest normalized-width midpoint split, r/theta/v/psi tie order
raw_independence: every fixture/mode/resolution/budget new full-domain queue, cache and counters; no carryover or cumulative use
domain_partition_closed: valid full-domain partition consisting only of certified rejected boxes, uniformly compatible retained boxes, or retained possible terminal boxes at frozen resolution, after natural queue exhaustion
compatibility_certified: diagnostic cell upper-bound proof only, never a necessary condition for conservative retained support closure
search_budget_closed: queue exhausted naturally before any operation/storage cap; cap-triggered flushing is not natural exhaustion
scientific_support: certified-compatible plus terminal-possible cells; capped/invalid regions retained as unresolved conservative diagnostics and never silently omitted; failed closure blocks scientific Gate
invalid_stop: Any invalid bound/accounting or closed partition excluding matched reference -> IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID and stop; no source/threshold/fixture swap
ordering: Policy commit and verified push before any analytic single-path toy/test or physical closure fixture; no additional fixture or ladder after results.
stop: After corrected checkpoint commit/push; no development release, fresh, N1, A2/depth/SSP/P5.
